criteria.evidence: Response explains the general mechanism ('LLM picks a tool based on name/description + conversation context') common to all frameworks, but never traces the user's specific agent architecture (no details were requested before giving diagnosis); only at the end does it ask for framework/model and example.

Provides a generic list of six possible causes (ambiguous descriptions, too many tools, missing few-shot, weak prompt, model choice, no verification) rather than pinpointing a single 'first' incorrect boundary specific to the user's setup.
'Switching frameworks is unlikely to fix this by itself' and 'My actual suggestion: stay on your current framework and try this first' explicitly avoid recommending an architectural replacement.
